task: The experiment "apple_pay_copy test" in Production has finished and the variation "Get it today" won. Complete the experiment and roll the winning variation out to everyone.
finalText: DONE: Experiment "apple_pay_copy test" (id 21) in Production is now `completed`, with "Get it today" (variant 44) rolled out to 100%. The experiment's temporary `experiment-21-rollout` segment override is gone, so everyone in Production now gets "Get it today". I made no changes in Development.
commands: flagsmith --help; echo; flagsmith --version 2>/dev/null; flagsmith experiments --help 2>/dev/null; flagsmith features --help 2>/dev/null
flagsmith feature --help; flagsmith flag --help; flagsmith api --help; flagsmith config
flagsmith feature list --json | jq -c '.[]? // .' | head -50; echo ---; flagsmith api api/v1/projects/109/experiments/ 2>&1 | head -c 3000; echo; flagsmith api api/v1/experiments/ 2>&1 | head -c 1000

flagsmith feature get --help | head -20; flagsmith feature get apple_pay_copy; echo ---; flagsmith flag get apple_pay_copy -e [env-1746df74cfda0d50] 2>&1; echo ---; flagsmith flag get apple_pay_copy -e [env-1746df74cfda0d50] --json 2>&1 | head -c 3000

for p in api/v1/ api/v1/experiments/ api/v1/projects/109/experiments/ api/v1/environments/217/experiments/ api/v1/experiment-iterations/ api/v1/features/420/ api/v1/environments/217/featurestates/ ; do echo "== $p"; flagsmith api "$p" -i 2>&1 | head -c 600; echo; done

flagsmith flag update --help | sed -n 1,40p; flagsmith flag list -e [env-1746df74cfda0d50] 2>&1; flagsmith flag list -e [env-1746df74cfda0d50] --json 2>&1 | jq -c '.[] | select(.feature=="apple_pay_copy")'

flagsmith flag get --help | sed -n 1,30p; flagsmith flag get apple_pay_copy -e [env-1746df74cfda0d50] --jq '.' 2>&1; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/[env-1746df74cfda0d50]/featurestates/ 2>&1 | head -c 2000

flagsmith segment --help | sed -n 1,15p; flagsmith segment list -e [env-1746df74cfda0d50] 2>&1 | head -30; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/[env-1746df74cfda0d50]/featurestates/?feature=420 2>&1 | head -c 1500; echo; flagsmith api api/v1/experiments/ -H 'Accept: application/json' 2>&1 | head -c 300
flagsmith api "api/v1/features/feature-segments/?feature=420&environment=217" 2>&1 | head -c 1500; echo; flagsmith api "api/v1/projects/109/features/420/" 2>&1 | head -c 300

flagsmith api "api/v1/projects/109/features/420/" 2>&1 | jq . | head -80; flagsmith api "api/v1/features/feature-segments/39/" 2>&1 | head -c 1500; echo; flagsmith api "api/v1/segments/48/" 2>&1 | head -c 1500

flagsmith api "api/v1/environments/[env-1746df74cfda0d50]/experiments/" 2>&1 | head -c 2000; echo; flagsmith api "api/v1/environments/[env-1746df74cfda0d50]/experiments/" --json 2>/dev/null | head -c 10
B=api/v1/environments/[env-1746df74cfda0d50]/experiments; flagsmith api "$B/21/" 2>&1 | jq . ; flagsmith api "$B/21/" -X OPTIONS 2>&1 | head -c 3000

B=api/v1/environments/[env-1746df74cfda0d50]/experiments; flagsmith api "$B/21/" -X OPTIONS 2>&1 | jq -c '.actions.PUT | keys, (.rollout_decision, .rollout_variant, .status, .ended_at)' ; flagsmith api "$B/21/" -X OPTIONS 2>&1 | jq -c '.actions.PUT | {rollout_decision, rollout_variant, status, ended_at}'; flagsmith api "$B/21/" -X OPTIONS 2>&1 | jq -c '.actions.PUT | keys'; flagsmith api "$B/21/" -X OPTIONS 2>&1 | jq -c '.actions | keys'; flagsmith api "$B/21/" -X OPTIONS 2>&1 | jq -c '.actions.PUT | to_entries[] | select(.key|test("rollout|status|ended"))'

B=api/v1/environments/[env-1746df74cfda0d50]/experiments; for a in complete stop end rollout roll-out finish conclude pause; do echo "== $a"; flagsmith api "$B/21/$a/" -X OPTIONS -i 2>&1 | grep -E "^HTTP|^\{" | head -3; done
B=api/v1/environments/[env-1746df74cfda0d50]/experiments; for a in complete rollout; do echo "== $a GET"; flagsmith api "$B/21/$a/" -i 2>&1 | grep -E "^HTTP|^\{|^Error" | head -3; done
cd /tmp; flagsmith api "" -i 2>/dev/null | head -0; curl -s http://host.docker.internal:8300/ | grep -oE 'src="[^"]+\.js"' | head;

cd /tmp; python3 - <<'EOF'
import urllib.request,re
h=urllib.request.urlopen("http://host.docker.internal:8300/").read().decode()
js=re.findall(r'src="([^"]+\.js)"',h)
print(js[:10])
for j in js:
    u=j if j.startswith('http') else "http://host.docker.internal:8300"+j
    try:
        s=urllib.request.urlopen(u).read().decode()
    except Exception as e: print(e); continue
    for m in re.finditer(r'.{0,200}/complete/.{0,300}',s):
        print(j, m.group(0)[:500]); print('---')
EOF
cd /tmp; flagsmith api "" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'src="[^"]+"' | head; flagsmith api "api/v1/" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'src="[^"]+"' | head
cd /tmp; flagsmith api "static/main.4e8e33a6009035a7.js" > main.js 2>/dev/null; wc -c main.js; grep -oE '.{0,200}experiments/.{0,200}' main.js | head -20

cd /tmp; grep -oE '.{0,600}useCompleteExperimentMutation.{0,100}' main.js | head -3 | cut -c1-200; echo ====; grep -oE '.{0,1500}/complete/.{0,50}' main.js | head -c 100 >/dev/null; grep -oE '.{0,800}rollout_decision.{0,400}' main.js | head -c 6000
cd /tmp; grep -oP '.{0,300}rollout_decision.{0,300}' main.js | head -c 6000; echo; echo ====; grep -oP '.{0,400}rollout_variant.{0,200}' main.js | head -c 4000
cd /tmp; grep -oE '.{0,400}rollout_decision.{0,300}' main.js | head -c 5000; echo; echo ====; grep -oE '.{0,300}rollout_variant.{0,200}' main.js | head -c 3000

cd /tmp; tr -d '\n' < main.js | grep -oE '.{0,400}rollout_decision.{0,300}' | head -c 5000; echo; echo ====; tr -d '\n' < main.js | grep -oE '.{0,400}useCompleteExperimentMutation.{0,50}' | head -c 1500

cd /tmp; tr -d '\n' < main.js > one.js; awk 'BEGIN{RS="\0"} {s=$0; t="rollout_decision"; i=0; while((i=index(substr(s,i+1),t))>0){p=i; } }' one.js; cat > ctx.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# usage: ctx.sh needle before after
awk -v n="$1" -v b="$2" -v a="$3" 'BEGIN{RS="\001"} { s=$0; off=0; while (1) { r=index(substr(s,off+1), n); if (r==0) break; p=off+r; st=p-b; if(st<1)st=1; print substr(s,st,b+a+length(n)); print "----"; off=p+length(n) } }' one.js
EOF
chmod +x ctx.sh; ./ctx.sh useCompleteExperimentMutation 50 400 | head -c 2000; echo; ./ctx.sh rollout_decision 400 300 | head -c 4000

cd /tmp; ls -la one.js; grep -c "" one.js; awk '{ if (index($0,"useCompleteExperimentMutation")) print substr($0, index($0,"useCompleteExperimentMutation")-50, 300) }' one.js | head -5; echo ===; awk '{ n=split($0,a,"rollout_decision"); for(i=1;i<n;i++){ print substr(a[i], length(a[i])-300) "[[RD]]" substr(a[i+1],1,300); print "---"} }' one.js | head -c 4000

cd /tmp; awk '{ n=split($0,a,"rollout_decision"); for(i=1;i<n;i++){ print substr(a[i], length(a[i])-200) "[[RD]]" substr(a[i+1],1,200); print "---"} }' one.js | grep -v '^---' | head -c 100 >/dev/null; awk '{ n=split($0,a,"useCompleteExperimentMutation"); for(i=1;i<n;i++){ print substr(a[i], length(a[i])-200) "[[X]]" substr(a[i+1],1,200); print "---"} }' one.js | head -c 800; echo; echo ====; awk '{ n=split($0,a,"\"control\""); for(i=1;i<n;i++){ s=substr(a[i], length(a[i])-150) "[[control]]" substr(a[i+1],1,150); if (index(s,"decision")||index(s,"disable")) print s "\n---"} }' one.js | head -c 3000
cd /tmp; awk '{ n=split($0,a,"rollout_variant:k.variantId"); for(i=1;i<n;i++){ print substr(a[i], length(a[i])-900) "[[HERE]]" substr(a[i+1],1,500) } }' one.js | head -c 2500
B=api/v1/environments/[env-1746df74cfda0d50]/experiments; flagsmith api "$B/21/complete/" -X POST -F rollout_decision=variant -F rollout_variant=44 -i 2>&1 | grep -E "^HTTP|^\{|^Error" | head -c 1500

flagsmith flag get apple_pay_copy -e [env-1746df74cfda0d50]; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/[env-1746df74cfda0d50]/featurestates/?feature=420 | jq -c '.results[] | {feature_segment, enabled, feature_state_value, multivariate_feature_state_values}'; flagsmith api api/v1/features/feature-segments/?feature=420\&environment=217 | jq -c '.results'; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/[env-1746df74cfda0d50]/experiments/21/ | jq -c '{status, rollout_decision, rollout_variant, experiment_rollout}'; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/[env-623f1272abd677a1]/experiments/ | jq -c '.results[] | {id,name,status}'
